name: Cookie Consent Notice by CookieYes
description: This plugin allows you to add the CookieYes script on overall site from the front-end. No need to open files and add them there.
project_description:
The CookieYes consent module for Drupal (versions 8/9/10/11) provides an easy solution for managing cookie consent and compliance with data privacy laws, including GDPR and US State Laws such as CCPA/CPRA. This module simplifies the integration of CookieYes scripts directly into your Drupal site from the front-end, eliminating the need to modify backend files.

 Key Features 
 
 Fully customizable opt-in and opt-out cookie banners with multilingual support. 
 Single-click automatic scanning and categorization of cookies. 
 Automatically blocks scripts that set non-essential cookies until the user gives consent. 
 Logs records of consent from site visitors and generates a "proof of consent" document for each entry. 
 Geo-targets banners to appear only in specific geographic regions. 
 Supports integration with Google Consent Mode (GCM) and IAB Europe's Transparency & Consent Framework (TCF). 
 Privacy and Cookie Policy generators. 
 
 For instructions on implementing the CookieYes cookie consent banner on your Drupal website, check out our setup guide .

 If you have any queries or need further assistance, please contact us .
